findings.prediction_columns: Two class probabilities in class order [0,1], not a prediction and a metadata column.
findings.metadata_location: Separate metadata object, as read by the capture code and declared by the published API schema.
findings.output_inclusive_count_hypothesis: 182+2=184 fits full-data arithmetic, but a uniform input-plus-output count is contradicted by both earlier runs. A branch-specific server counting change remains unverified.
findings.capture_gap: Old capture saved selected fields and valid probabilities only. Unknown response fields, their names, and timings were not retained. We cannot establish that the original server response lacked feature names.
findings.retrieval: Published REST routes and inspected SDK expose no identified read-only prediction-response retrieval method. MCP prediction download URLs do not establish retrieval for this existing REST call.
findings.acceptance: No acceptance override or new prediction.
